[simp]
account="dreamhost"

[clojureverse.org]
MX="0 mx1.dreamhost.com."
MX="0 mx2.dreamhost.com."
TXT="v=spf1 mx include:netblocks.dreamhost.com include:relay.mailchannels.net -all"

[_autodiscover._tcp.clojureverse.org]
SRV="5 0 443 autoconfig.dreamhost.com"

[_autodiscover._tcp.lists.clojureverse.org]
SRV="5 0 443 autoconfig.dreamhost.com"

[autoconfig.clojureverse.org]
CNAME="autoconfig.dreamhost.com"

[autoconfig.lists.clojureverse.org]
CNAME="autoconfig.dreamhost.com"

[dreamhost._domainkey.clojureverse.org]
TXT="v=DKIM1; k=rsa; h=sha256;  "

[dreamhost._domainkey.lists.clojureverse.org]
TXT="v=DKIM1; k=rsa; h=sha256;  "


# Local Variables:
# mode:conf
# End:
